lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect IPC classification data across Nicaragua. Survey results were spatially coded by administrative or geographic units and compiled into GeoJSON/KML formats representing acute food insecurity phases for near-term projections in 2022.
